item.description: Those who want to help are overwhelmed.

item.title: REAL ESTATE BRIEFS
item.description: Nevada Rural Housing, in partnership with the Nevada Housing Coalition, announced its Keys to the Missing Middle Homeownership Education Program, a statewide initiative designed to help Nevada households prepare for and sustain successful homeownership.

item.title: Pulte’s Brantley opens in Summerlin’s Grand Park village
item.description: Brantley by Pulte Homes is the newest neighborhood to open in Summerlin. Located in Grand Park village, Brantley is one of several neighborhoods located near the village’s namesake park, — Grand Park — which will be the largest park in the community upon completion.

item.title: Lake Las Vegas announces golf cart giveaway winner
item.description: Lake Las Vegas has named the winner of its fall golf cart giveaway, an incentive offered to buyers who purchased a new home from a preferred builder during the promotional period.

item.title: Cadence, Summerlin in top 10 U.S. communities
item.description: Led by Cadence in east Henderson at No. 3, Las Vegas had four master-planned communities ranked in the top 50 of the nation, including another top 10 showing for Summerlin.

item.title: Rebels fall to rival UNR for 3rd straight loss
item.description: Dra Gibbs-Lawhorn scored 26 points, but UNLV’s basketball team lost at rival UNR on Friday at Lawlor Events Center.

item.title: Democracy Prep girls upend Centennial in 5A state title game rematch
item.description: Brayana Miles hit the go-ahead free throw in the waning seconds to secure Democracy Prep’s victory over Centennial in a girls basketball game Friday.

item.title: No. 1 Liberty outlasts No. 2 Bishop Gorman at the buzzer — PHOTOS
item.description: Liberty’s boys basketball team kept itself in first place in the Class 5A Southern League standings after winning a wild game against rival Bishop Gorman on Friday.
